body:
Windows B change (Greg, 2026-11-25 ~23:00Z, relayed by Engram::Asistant 588693a8 #2774): „Zrobiłem update biosu. Ustawiłem rust tools na stable.” Greg also asked whether a Rust benchmark is still running there; Asistant asked a read-only WinB session.

Effects:
- WinB's BIOS was updated.
- WinB's Rust toolchain default is now STABLE. Previously it may have been a different channel or pin.
- The first TermAl or Engram Rust build on WinB after this is effectively COLD: a new toolchain means existing target/ caches are not reused. Expect compile-time cost. A different rustc version is not a test failure, but any new warning or error from the toolchain change is investigated as an environment cause, not rerun.
- If a project pins a toolchain (rust-toolchain file), the pin still wins over the default.

WinB stays at Greg's disposal: no new team starts until he says it's back. The freeze is recorded in central-queue.txt.
